newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Kosovo group alleges Albanian died after torture.
newsitem.headline: Kosovo group alleges Albanian died after torture.

text.p: A political group charged on Thursday that an ethnic Albanian in Serbia's troubled province of Kosovo had died as a result of being tortured by police.
The Democratic League of Kosovo (LDK) said Feriz Blakcori, 34, died on Tuesday in a hospital in the provincial capital, Pristina, as a "result of police torture".
Blackcori was arrested in his home on Monday by a 40-strong police unit on suspicion of possessing firearms, LDK said in a statement faxed to news organisations.
Blakcori, a father of two, was a member of LDK's information commission and a teacher in a local elementary school.
Serbian authorities in the province, where Albanians outnumber Serbs nine to one, could not be reached for comment. There was no official statement on the alleged incident.
The province has been rocked by a wave of killings of Serbian policemen and attacks on Serbian security forces over the past year.
LDK says Blackori was the 14th victim of Serbian authorities this year.
None of the claims could be independently confirmed.
Serbia cracked down on the province's autonomy in 1989 claiming its Albanian leaders wanted to secede from the republic. The Serbs regard Kosovo as the cradle of their culture.
The Albanians reacted by boycotting Serbian institutions and formed their own shadow government and parliament.
